lesson.procedure: Verify the named worktree, branch, HEAD and clean status; acquire a path claim there before writing.
lesson.title: Bind work to an exact clean worktree and HEAD

lesson.procedure: Record the required owner role and decision; do not infer a person, response, or acceptance when the evidence is blank.
lesson.title: Treat owner roles as decision gates, not assumed people

lesson.procedure: Compare the current evidence hash and state with the last readback; if unchanged, record no progress and wait for a new signal or choose an independent bounded action.
lesson.title: Do not repeat a no-change audit without a new signal

lesson.procedure: Read the command help and input sizes, reduce the selected context to required tracked files, then retry once; do not repeat the same failing arguments.
lesson.title: Inspect claim inputs and bounds before retrying

lesson.procedure: Bind a named internal engineering reviewer to the relevant track contract and exact source commit. Resolve ordinary architectural decisions through a scoped ADR and independent review. Before escalating, identify an actual external authority and concrete action requiring approval; a track number or blank disposition is insufficient. Preserve real external approval and release gates.
lesson.title: Resolve internal owner-role decisions within existing user authority

review.note: User approved internal owner-role reviews; ADR-0009 records this scope and preserves genuine external gates. This is procedural validation, not a competence claim.
Applied exact active-worktree and HEAD binding with claims before integration; source guide supports this bounded procedure.

use.note: Bound cb5f4d7 integration checkout and exact four-file learning worker diff; scope check and 14 learning tests passed before commit 6ff622f.

outcome.note: Actual integration used the intended worktree, retained worker isolation, and committed only claimed outputs. This does not quantify a performance improvement.

use.note: Assigned internal DES/ABM and model/runner reviewers, resolved ADR-0009 route-receipt design, and dispatched the bounded leaf under the user instruction to proceed.

outcome.note: Actual Kairos dbe7c34 implementation passed 462 combined Rust1.99 tests and independent source review. This opened implementation after owner-role assumptions had stalled it; full C2 and checkpoint acceptance remain open. Receipt: conductor/evidence/c2-learning-progress-20261009/acceptance.json.

lesson.procedure: For a hash-chained append log, lock the complete read/validate/state-transition/append sequence. O_APPEND alone does not prevent two writers from choosing the same predecessor hash. Verify with real simultaneous subprocess writers and retained history; bound reads before allocation.
lesson.title: Lock the full state transition before append-only writes

review.note: Independent root review identified the initial O_APPEND race; repaired implementation and real eight-process append test were read and rerun with 14 focused tests passing.

use.note: Applied full-transition flock to the new learning store and tested eight simultaneous proposals in temporary repositories.

outcome.note: The eight-process regression reconstructs one valid complete chain; review fixed a concrete integrity defect. This proves that case only, not malicious tamper resistance or general agent improvement.

lesson.procedure: For paused movement, test resume while the previous progress event is still queued. Assert the old event is ignored exactly once after resume and the replacement arrives at the independently computed time. Retain failure/pass logs and verify no work/request or RNG duplication; draining the old event while paused can hide replacement bookkeeping defects.
lesson.title: Exercise resume before an older queued event is consumed

outcome.note: Found/corrected a concrete runtime, environment or oracle issue while preserving original scope. Full C2, general recovery and release acceptance remain unproved.

lesson.procedure: Use the selected Rustup sysroot bin directory first in PATH, bind RUSTC/RUSTDOC and use an isolated Cargo target when validating. Same rustc version strings from Homebrew and Rustup do not prove compatible metadata. Diagnose E0514 as a toolchain/cache mismatch before changing source; retain failed attempt and corrected command.
lesson.title: Bind Cargo, compiler and Clippy driver to one toolchain build

lesson.procedure: Trace the failed assertion to the normative field semantics. Preserve historical fixture bytes and failed evidence; if its observation is invalid, approve an explicit versioned oracle that retains the original behavior requirements and checks the correct runtime record. Never change runtime semantics or silently weaken assertions just to get green.
lesson.title: Resolve an obsolete test observation against the actual contract
